translations.web: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
translations.bsb: Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
translations.kjv: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
translations.asv: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.
